title: The conformal limit for Nakajima quiver varieties
summary: Inspired by Gaiotto's conformal limit construction for Higgs bundles we define and study a conformal limit construction for Nakajima quiver varieties. We prove that the conformal limit is indeed a limit of a one parameter family of points inside a specified quiver variety and that it gives a biholomorphic map between holomorphic Lagrangian submanifolds foliating two different quiver varieties. In the last part of the paper we discuss the analog of Simpson's conjecture on the completeness of these holomorphic Lagrangian submanifolds.
